stories.title: 3 killed, 36 injured in attacks on Riyadh and Abha airports

en.title: 3 killed, 36 injured in attacks on Riyadh and Abha airports

en.summary: A UN peacekeeping position near the Israel-Lebanon border was targeted by small-arms fire on Wednesday with no casualties reported. The UN force characterized the shooting as deliberate and unacceptable.

stories.title: Three people killed and dozens injured in attacks on Riyadh and Abha airports

en.title: Three people killed and dozens injured in attacks on Riyadh and Abha airports
en.summary: Coordinated attacks on Saudi airports resulted in three deaths and multiple injuries. Two women were killed in a Tuesday attack on Abha International Airport, while a separate incident occurred at King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh on Wednesday.

stories.title: Houthis strike Aden airport as number of people displaced by latest Yemen fighting tops 200,000

en.title: Houthis strike Aden airport as number of people displaced by latest Yemen fighting tops 200,000
en.summary: Yemen-based Houthis launched missiles and drones at Aden International Airport on Wednesday in the first attack on the facility in years. Over 200,000 people have been displaced since fighting escalated in August.

en.title: AlJazira Capital issues Q3 2026 earnings forecasts
